audit.whatIsWrong: diff read HARD but diffRating said 4/10 and the summary line said 'Favoured matchup', against a 32.14% win rate. The chart also gave Karma level 6 and Yorick level 3.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Karma, Karma, Skill, Yorick, Yorick, Yorick, Yorick, and the content why for level 6 describes Maiden plus the bone wall as an all-in Karma cannot survive — not a Karma row. Level 3 is where the content says the lane 'evens out', i.e. Skill.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Karma, row 2 to Skill, row 4 to Yorick on both layers; difficulty 8/10, carry threat 8/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase whys were Karma boilerplate claiming she owns the lane as a toll booth.
audit.why: Yorick's spikes are Mourning Mist at 3 (12s at rank 1 — mark, slow, armour shred that his ghouls leap onto), Eulogy of the Isles at 6 (Maiden floods the wave), and health/Maiden scaling into the side lane. Karma has no level-6 spike.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0..6].why to those spikes with the Mourning Mist cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said to 'sidestep or break' Dark Procession without stating it is destructible or giving a cooldown, and never mentioned that Last Rites is an auto-attack reset that heals him.
audit.why: Dark Procession is a destructible wall, 20/18/16/14/12s — breaking it is the actual escape, and knowing it is 20s at rank 1 tells you when stepping up is safe. Last Rites is a 6s auto-reset with a self-heal, so the attack wind-up is the burst tell and Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession (Cage): matchup-defining — The cage traps you with the ghoul swarm — sidestep or break it instantly. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Dark Procession: 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — the wall is destructible, so break it rather than waiting inside with the ghouls. - Last Rites is an auto-reset that heals him: the wind-up is the tell, and anti-heal blunts it. - Hold E for the all-in.

edits.after: Levels 1-2 are your only window: RQ Soulflare his step-ups, last-hit at max Q range, and hold E strictly for his wall-and-ghoul all-in.
